package.name: marine_contacts
package.description: Qt-free builder + manual-curation store for marine_interfaces/Contact: build a BOX Contact from a map-frame footprint, query a contact set by bounding box, persist as a CDR ContactArray, and export GeoJSON. Deps are intentionally tiny (marine_interfaces + rclcpp) so any Contact producer — the operator UI today, an automated detector tomorrow — can link it without pulling a UI/perception toolchain. Extracted from marine_perception_tools (see rqt_operator_tools#86).
